name: AHR interacting HSP90 co-chaperone

function.text: AIP encodes AH receptor-interacting protein. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase activity. It participates in protein maturation and protein localization to mitochondrion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to growth hormone secreting pituitary adenoma 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
